boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Florida Southern rituals that turn finals, Fridays, basketball, winter, food, films, and a Frank Lloyd Wright fountain into distinctly Moccasin traditions.

cards.title: Take the Senior Splash
cards.subtitle: Graduating seniors enter the J. Edgar Wall Water Dome each spring
cards.notes: Wait for the authorized senior event, then join the class swim; entering the Water Dome at other times is prohibited and may result in a fine.
cards.short_summary: A normally off-limits Frank Lloyd Wright fountain becomes a once-per-class swimming spot for graduating Mocs.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern identifies Water Dome Splash as a spring tradition in which graduating seniors join the college president for a swim in the Water Dome.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to the college-authorized event for graduating seniors; ordinary entry into the Water Dome is prohibited.

cards.title: Turn Friday Really Red
cards.subtitle: Weekly school-color ritual led by the Student Government Association
cards.notes: Wear red on Friday and stop by the SGA activity if one is announced; prizes are possible, but the college does not promise one to every participant.
cards.short_summary: Florida Southern turns its school color into a weekly wearable campus ritual.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern states that every Friday is Red Shirt Friday and invites participants to wear red, with possible prizes from SGA.
cards.access_notes: The tradition occurs on Fridays; check current SGA communications for any prize distribution details.

cards.title: Pack the Bus for the Mocs
cards.subtitle: SGA-organized basketball road support at a rival campus
cards.notes: Watch SGA announcements during basketball season, reserve a place if required, and follow the organized trip rules while cheering at the away game.
cards.short_summary: Mocs turn an away basketball matchup into a coordinated student road trip.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern documents Pack the Bus as an SGA-hosted basketball-season event that takes students to a rival campus to cheer for the Mocs.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal organized trip; transportation, eligibility, registration, and game details must be confirmed with SGA.

cards.title: Let Faculty Serve Finals Breakfast
cards.subtitle: A Wynee’s Bistro study-break ritual during Finals Week
cards.notes: Check the semester event notice, then bring your student identification and take a finals-study break while FSC faculty and staff serve breakfast.
cards.short_summary: Finals Week briefly reverses campus roles when faculty and staff serve students at Wynee’s Bistro.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern says Late-Night Breakfast occurs every semester during Finals Week at Wynee’s Bistro and is served by FSC staff and faculty.
cards.access_notes: Held late at night during Finals Week; the official traditions page does not publish a precise current time, so verify the semester announcement.

cards.title: Show Up for Southern Takeover
cards.subtitle: The Association of Campus Entertainment’s annual student concert
cards.notes: Look for the annual ACE announcement and follow its entry instructions; the college specifically identifies the concert as free for students.
cards.short_summary: Florida Southern’s student-programming group stages one named major concert each year.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern states that the Association of Campus Entertainment hosts Southern Takeover annually as its major concert and that the show is free for students.
cards.access_notes: Free for Florida Southern students; verify the current date, venue, identification requirements, and any capacity limit with ACE.

cards.title: Say Fair-Well to the Academic Year
cards.subtitle: A spring sendoff built around fair-style activities
cards.notes: Check the spring event listing, then plan time for the advertised rides, music, novelties, and fair food before the academic year closes.
cards.short_summary: The college makes its end-of-year goodbye literal with a campus fair called Fair-Well.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern describes Fair-Well Festival as a spring farewell to the academic year featuring fair food, rides, novelties, and music.
cards.access_notes: Spring campus-community event; verify the current schedule, participation rules, and any charges for particular offerings.

cards.title: Track Down Dino Nugget Night
cards.subtitle: Wynee’s Bistro serves dinosaur-shaped nuggets during the academic year
cards.notes: Check Wynee’s current menu before heading over; the college documents recurring dino nuggets but does not publish fixed dates or meal-access terms.
cards.short_summary: A dining-hall menu item became recognizable enough to earn its own student-made alert account.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern documents Dino Nugget Night as a recurring Wynee’s Bistro offering during the academic year and notes a student-created notification account.
cards.access_notes: Offered at unspecified times during the academic year; confirm the current Wynee’s Bistro menu and dining-access requirements.

cards.title: Watch Southern Cinema Under the Stars
cards.subtitle: ACE mixes blockbusters, throwbacks, and drive-in screenings
cards.notes: Check ACE’s current film announcement, bring only permitted seating or supplies, and confirm whether that screening is outdoors or drive-in style.
cards.short_summary: The campus movie series changes formats, including open-air and drive-in presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern says the Association of Campus Entertainment hosts Southern Cinema throughout the year with blockbusters, throwback films, and drive-in movies.
cards.access_notes: Dates, titles, locations, weather plans, and attendance eligibility vary by screening; confirm them through ACE.

cards.title: Slide into a Florida Winter
cards.subtitle: An end-of-fall celebration with a giant tree and snow slides
cards.notes: Follow the Center for Student Involvement’s end-of-semester notice, dress for the activities, and observe the posted snow-slide rules.
cards.short_summary: Florida Southern stages snow slides in Lakeland as the fall semester reaches its finish.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern identifies World of Winter as a Center for Student Involvement celebration at the end of fall semester featuring a gigantic tree, snow slides, and activities.
cards.access_notes: End-of-fall campus-community event; confirm the current date, location, weather plan, and activity restrictions.

cards.title: Launch—or Relaunch—Your Club Life
cards.subtitle: A twice-yearly showcase for Florida Southern student organizations
cards.notes: Visit the semester showcase, scan the club tables before committing, and ask organization representatives about meeting times and membership steps.
cards.short_summary: Florida Southern resets its involvement fair every semester for both new starts and fresh starts.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern says Blast Off and Relaunch occurs every semester, showcases more than 100 student clubs and organizations, and includes free food and giveaways.
cards.access_notes: Semester campus event; verify the current date, location, and student attendance requirements through campus involvement channels.
